description: Implementation of MojoCdm class managing Content Decryption Module (CDM) interactions via Mojo IPC, including session management, promise handling, and error handling.

classes.name: MojoCdm
classes.description: Manages communication with a remote Content Decryption Module (CDM) via Mojo IPC, handles session lifecycle, promise resolution, and error handling.

methods.name: MojoCdm
methods.description: Constructor initializing MojoCdm with remote CDM, context, config, and callbacks.

methods.name: ~MojoCdm
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources, rejecting promises, and closing sessions.

methods.name: OnConnectionError
methods.description: Handles Mojo connection errors, resets remote, rejects promises, and closes sessions.

methods.name: SetServerCertificate
methods.description: Sets the server certificate via remote CDM.

methods.name: GetStatusForPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves key status for a specified HDCP policy.

methods.name: CreateSessionAndGenerateRequest
methods.description: Creates a new session and generates a request.

methods.name: LoadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: UpdateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with response data.

methods.name: CloseSession
methods.description: Closes an existing session.

methods.name: RemoveSession
methods.description: Removes a session.

methods.name: GetCdmContext
methods.description: Returns the current CdmContext (this object).

methods.name: RegisterEventCB
methods.description: Registers an event callback.

methods.name: GetDecryptor
methods.description: Returns a Decryptor instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: GetCdmId
methods.description: Returns the CDM ID if available.

methods.name: RequiresMediaFoundationRenderer
methods.description: Returns whether Media Foundation Renderer is required (Windows only).

methods.name: OnSessionMessage
methods.description: Handles session message events.

methods.name: OnSessionClosed
methods.description: Handles session closed events.

methods.name: OnSessionKeysChange
methods.description: Handles key change events.

methods.name: OnSessionExpirationUpdate
methods.description: Handles session expiration updates.

methods.name: OnSimpleCdmPromiseResult
methods.description: Handles result of simple CDM promises.

methods.name: OnKeyStatusCdmPromiseResult
methods.description: Handles key status promise results.

methods.name: OnNewSessionCdmPromiseResult
methods.description: Handles new session promise results.

methods.name: RejectPromiseConnectionLost
methods.description: Rejects a promise due to lost connection.
